scope: Visual inspection of actual mGBA screenshots, not merely generator artwork or scaled marketing images
findings: All eight scenes preserve full-world viewport with floating corner HUD and clearly outlined player/companion bodies
Cream paths, teal boundaries and coral/kelp silhouettes remain distinguishable at native size
Town shell buildings, tall archive shelving, garden roof and concentric listening chamber provide different landmarks
Movable baffles and puzzle markers remain separated from walking paths; temporary short Japanese hints occupy the bottom only while active
Archive chambers intentionally use open floor around interactive targets; environmental density is modest rather than commercial-game parity
limits: Finite captured views, not an exhaustive screenshot proof of every camera coordinate
Bright cream backgrounds reduce contrast of some pale command details; outlines and active-state effects need continued review as later chapters grow
No physical handheld panel or color-response testing
